literal_meaning: গা (ত্বক) করকর (ঝিঁঝি বা কাঁপা অনুভূতি) করা
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা শুনে গা করকর করল।
example_sentences_in_english: This heat is making my skin crawl.
Hearing his words made me feel unbearable discomfort.
note: The idiom evokes a physical sensation of unease, commonly used in colloquial Bengali to describe something repulsive or hard to endure.
